risks.note: Success in media depends on the choice of subject matter and quality of treatment; consumer preferences evolve continually and shifts are visible only over the long term, making future success hard to predict. Revenues from any content are directly linked to viewership and audience interest, so content that fails to resonate creates a risk of revenue loss. Consumers associate each Network18 brand with certain types of content, and any event that damages a brand can adversely impact the business — brand strength is described as among the Company's most valuable assets.

The pace of technological change has accelerated across the media sector, where new business models have emerged and viewing habits have been fundamentally transformed. The entire content value chain from news gathering and production to distribution is increasingly technology-driven, directly affecting content presentation, working efficiencies and operational costs, creating an ongoing challenge to remain current and pick the right technical solutions.

Growth of the digital economy has increased opportunities for cyber criminals to infiltrate sensitive IT infrastructure through phishing and other malicious practices, while advances in Generative AI create a new risk frontier by enabling automated vulnerability discovery and exploitation and supply chain attacks. The Company aligns its IT security landscape with the NIST framework and is ISO 27001-2022 certified.

The Indian regulatory landscape for media is constantly evolving across distribution, taxation and content censorship, and reporting requirements under SEBI, MCA and taxation laws have increased manifold. Any change by TRAI or the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting requires proactive realignment of corporate performance objectives alongside compliance with new requirements.

All of the Company's debt consists of short-term debt raised from capital markets, exposing it to the risk of capital unavailability due to macroeconomic factors such as liquidity conditions, interest rate volatility and the broader economic environment.

The Company's ability to operate effectively and implement its business strategies depends in part on the continued contributions of its executive officers and other key employees, who may be difficult to replace, retain or recruit amid intense competition and scarcity of specialist talent in media and entertainment.

The MD&A forward-looking statement names the important factors that could influence the Company's operations: geo-political and economic developments, demand and supply conditions in the industry, input prices, changes in government regulations and tax laws, and other factors such as litigation.

currentContext.expansion: Network18 is an asset-light media business and discloses no manufacturing capacity or plant expansion; its build-out is in channels, digital products and technology infrastructure. During FY26 it launched CNBC-TV18 Prime (launched May 2025) as a new business-intelligence channel and News18 Delhi-NCR, extending its regional footprint, and rebranded News18 Lokmat as News18 Marathi in early 2026. On digital, the Company says it is continually expanding content coverage across its portfolio and upgrading its technology infrastructure to become a one-stop digital destination; the year saw the launch of Moneycontrol Super Pro, the premium subscription offering for active investors, the launch of secured lending in the Moneycontrol Fintech vertical supported by integrations with leading partners, and expansion of Moneycontrol's coverage of unlisted shares. News18.com expanded its utility ecosystem with Tools18, audio news, interactive formats, enriched city experiences and in-house interactive games, with investments in AI Studio and Feed Management System 2.0 to improve editorial productivity and scalability, plus AI-driven recommendations, 'Ask AI search', automated cricket liveblogs and CDP-led personalisation. Structurally, News18 Marathi Private Limited became a wholly owned subsidiary after acquisition of the balance stake from Lokmat Media Private Limited, and the Board approved its amalgamation into the Company subject to NCLT sanction. The Company states it is not engaged in manufacturing activities, is not an energy intensive unit, and incurred no expenditure on Research and Development during the year.
